scope: EP-B01 exact data forms and digest relations
EP-B02 platform evidence provenance and admission only

companion_document.byte_source: Exact committed Git blob bytes, before working-tree newline conversion; this documentation binding does not change any runtime raw-byte digest rule.

type_language.meaning: Closed-field normative data catalogue; not executable code or JSON Schema. All fields required; no implicit optional or extra fields.
type_language.grammar: A named type; list[Type]; optional[Type] (null or Type); literal:exact-string; literal-integer:exact-decimal.

primitives.Digest: Exactly 64 lowercase ASCII hexadecimal characters; SHA-256.
primitives.NonemptyText: Nonempty Unicode string; no implicit trimming or case conversion.
primitives.LocalId: Nonempty ASCII string matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*; fixed by the separately admitted input source.
primitives.RelativePath: Nonempty repository-relative path with / separators, no drive, leading slash, empty component, . or ..; exact validated source path.
primitives.CanonicalPath: Absolute, source-bound Windows path; final native-handle resolution, case/alias/reparse/ADS/hardlink rejection per unchanged S2-EO.
primitives.Integer: JSON integer, excluding bool and float.
primitives.ExistingAttemptJournalEntry: Unchanged validated S2EE/S2EF AttemptJournalEntry payload including schema_version and record_digest, as pinned by source manifest; no added fields.

canonicalization.existing_algorithm: ASCII JSON, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False; no trailing newline.
canonicalization.record_digest: SHA-256 of canonical object with only top-level record_digest removed; retain all nested record digests.
canonicalization.raw_sha256: SHA-256 of complete original file bytes, including any actual whitespace.
canonicalization.rejection: Reject duplicate JSON keys, missing/extra fields, wrong literal/types, invalid or mismatched digests, undeclared null, bool-as-integer and nonfinite numbers.
canonicalization.immutability: Use validated immutable value copies; no lazy source re-resolution or mutable input references.

lists.publisher_sources: Nonempty; sorted ascending by repository_relative_path; no duplicates; exact complete publisher source closure admitted by the code audit.
lists.recorder_sources: Nonempty; sorted ascending by repository_relative_path; no duplicates; exact recorder source closure admitted by the preregistration review.
lists.cases: Nonempty finite sequence, unique case_id, exactly the independently preregistered isolation-contract order; report must match profile one for one.
lists.gates_in_case: Nonempty unique GateId sequence in G1..G5 order; coverage fixed before observations.
lists.gate_assessments: Exactly five entries in G1..G5 order.
lists.basis_artifacts: Nonempty, sorted by path, no duplicate paths; exact raw hash and length; every item independently reviewed.
lists.gate_case_ids: Unique case IDs in profile order, subset of cases whose preregistered gates contain this gate; nonempty for G2,G3,G5.
lists.residual_assumptions: Nonempty, duplicate-free list in independently reviewed order; explicitly includes OS/driver/hardware barrier compliance and no physical power-loss experiment.

relations.roots: P,A,R and journal/artifact records retain existing validators and schema meanings. No new S2EFRecord kind. Private records are validated by a future separately audited publisher, not the old store.
relations.native_identity: Volume serial is zero-padded unsigned FILE_ID_INFO.VolumeSerialNumber numeric hex; FileId is FILE_ID_128's 16 bytes in native byte-array order. Both from the actual retained handle, not st_ino or content hash. Host is always bound. Missing native support is a blocked platform prerequisite, not a synthetic fallback.
relations.volume: Every ParentSet identity.volume, platform_context.volume, result_volume_identity and result_file_identity.volume must be equal within the admitted host context.
relations.plan_source: W.execution_plan_digest=P.record_digest; W.execution_authorization_digest=A.record_digest; W.source_manifest_digest=P.source_manifest_digest=validated SourceManifest.record_digest. A is valid for P and the original one-attempt study.
relations.context_source: W.platform_context=F.platform_context=B.platform_context=C.platform_context; host equals P.execution_domain.host_identity; runtime_identity_digest is the canonical SHA-256 of the full validated SourceManifest.runtime_identity value.
relations.parent_source: W.parent_directories=F.parent_directories=B.parent_directories=C.parent_directories. repository.path=P.execution_domain.canonical_repository_path; git_common.path=P.execution_domain.canonical_git_common_dir; ledger.path=P.execution_domain.durable_ledger_root; output.path=parent(P.publication_paths.final)=parent(P.publication_paths.staging). Native identities must match actual later handles throughout the operation.
relations.paths: W.publication_paths final/staging are exactly P.publication_paths final/staging; study_reservation=P.publication_paths.reservation=ledger.path/study_id; target_reservation=final+'.reservation.json'; completion_marker=final+'.completed.json'; authorization=ledger.path/(study_id+'.authorization.json'); durable_ledger_root=ledger.path; flat_record_prefix=study_id+'.'. Existing core record basenames unchanged. No additional file location for U or C.
relations.contracts: W and F backend_contract_id and s2eo_contract_digest equal the pinned S2-EO values; s2eq_contract_digest equals this contract artifact_digest. Future private source hashes do not mutate inner P/A/SourceManifest schemas or their generation.
relations.authorization: U.publication_plan_digest=W.record_digest; U.execution_authorization_digest=A.record_digest; U study_id/attempt_id equal W; U count=1. Its explicit_authorization bytes must name W and that exact one attempt; C pins U and an independent review of the authorization. No U digest in W.
relations.reservation: R remains the unchanged valid AttemptReservation for A/P/study/domain/attempt. T.reservation_digest=R.record_digest; T.publication_plan_digest=W.record_digest; T.publication_authorization_digest=U.record_digest; T execution_plan/authorization digests equal P/A; T study/attempt/backend equal W; T canonical_final_path=W.publication_paths.final; T parent_directory_identity=W.parent_directories.output.
relations.marker: M fields study/attempt/backend equal W and T; M.execution_plan_digest=P.record_digest; M.execution_authorization_digest=A.record_digest; M.source_manifest_digest=W.source_manifest_digest; M.platform_acceptance_digest=Q.record_digest=W.platform_acceptance_digest; M.reservation_digest=R.record_digest; M.target_reservation_digest=T.record_digest; M canonical_final_path and parent_directory_identity equal T/W; no direct extra W or U field in M.
relations.result: M result_file_identity from the retained post-rename handle; final-name handle identifies the same file. M result_byte_count/raw_sha256 bind complete canonical final bytes; result_artifact_digest equals the recomputed fully validated MatrixArtifact.record_digest. Byte and semantic receipt validation both required.
relations.terminal: M.terminal_journal_entry is the unchanged valid ordinal 114 COMPLETED record for R, previous_journal_entry_digest_or_null=validated SEALED-113.record_digest; sealed_artifact_digest_or_null=M.result_artifact_digest; cell_start_digest_or_null=null; cell_evidence_digest_or_null=null; error_or_null=null. Created only after E6. It does not assert its own later flush.
relations.evidence: Q.platform_profile_digest=F.record_digest; Q.platform_report_digest=B.record_digest; B.platform_profile_digest=F.record_digest. W.platform_acceptance_digest=Q.record_digest. B/F publisher_sources=W.publisher_sources=C.publisher_sources; B/F recorder_sources=C.recorder_sources. Sources verified against original artifacts and the independent source-closure review.
relations.admission: C is an external independently pinned immutable context, not supplied by W/Q or generated by publisher. C profile/report/acceptance digests equal F/B/Q; C publication_authorization_digest=U.record_digest; C code_audit/documentation_basis/parent_establishment_evidence equal Q references. All review files' raw bytes, size, provenance and actual content must be accepted independently. Unknown C identity rejects.
relations.no_cycles: F/profile and its preregistration precede isolated B; Q references F/B and prior code/documentation/parent evidence. Q does not reference W,U,R or the study result. W references Q and A; U references W; C is externally admitted after Q and U and is referenced by none of F/B/Q/W/U. R then T, result, SEALED, terminal and M follow. Reviews must not contain a reverse digest reference that creates a cycle.

preconditions: An independent preregistration review pins F, source closures, recorder-format contract, exact cases, isolated authorization, isolated attempt ID and isolated destinations before B is observed.
B comes from that admitted recorder invocation; transcript and raw case files have complete bytes, lengths and hashes with independently captured process exit code 0 and recording_status COMPLETE.

B has all and only F cases, exactly once and in order; each status OBSERVED_COMPLETE. NativeFailure is null only if no native call failed; otherwise it names the first failed call in the raw trace, with immediate native error capture.

The independent acceptance review parses complete raw traces against the pinned recorder format and each case's expected_observation_contract; checks source/handle/call sequence, full writes, barriers, rename, native errors and handle close evidence. Declared statuses alone cannot satisfy this.
Expected negative failures are accepted only for their preregistered negative case; no unexpected error or missing observation. Error 5 never proves positive publication capability.
Exact host/build/runtime, volume, parent identities, backend and complete source closures match F,B,C and later W/current handles. Drift is not repaired or interpreted as equivalent.

Q contains five ACCEPTED gates. G1 binds reviewed prior parent establishment/durability evidence for exact directories. G2 binds reviewed documentation for data and reservation/new-name/rename metadata to actual API traces. G3 binds no-replace/atomicity/identity/share/error evidence. G4 binds independent future implementation audit. G5 binds the exact isolated report provenance.
Every gate's basis artifacts are actually reviewed for the stated claim; G2,G3,G5 additionally reference matching original cases. Hash equality proves identity, not adequacy.
Documentation basis states OS/driver/storage assumptions; successful readback or native success alone cannot establish universal crash durability. No missing guarantee is silently inferred.

Q.status ACCEPTED only if every predicate holds; missing known guarantee is BLOCKED; missing/incomplete recording is INCOMPLETE (takes precedence if both apply). Non-ACCEPTED Q is never admitted at E0.
platform_admission.trust_anchor: An externally versioned static review pins AdmissionContext.record_digest. No submitted flag, hash-shaped string, mutable caller list or readable file supplies this trust root. Intentional repository-owner tampering is outside the existing trust boundary.
platform_admission.context_list_scope: Snapshot of absence at S2-EQ only, not a future mutable registry in this contract. A separately approved independent trust root pins any future C without changing S2-EQ, creating reverse digest links, or silently changing the already validated source commit. No such trust root is supplied now.
platform_admission.historical_s2em: s2em.001 access-denied/NOT_RUN diagnostics are historical only, not Q or evidence of a completed file-scoped publisher. No reuse or rerun authorized.
platform_admission.no_self_prerequisite: An isolated future platform invocation gathers evidence under its own approved profile; it does not require Q from its own future execution. All G1-G5 and Q are required only before study publisher use.
platform_admission.observation_schema_boundary: Exact native raw-trace schema is a FileRef to the separately preregistered recorder_format_contract. That future contract/code audit must fix it before any platform execution; S2-EQ defines the evidence envelope and admission, not new probe implementation or test budget.

gate_mapping.E0: Validate complete P/A/W/U/F/B/Q/C, paths and parents before R creation. Missing or inapplicable platform evidence -> existing BLOCKED_PLATFORM_PREREQUISITE.
gate_mapping.E2: Check T against already validated W/U/P/A/R and current native parent; retain consumed study reservation on failure.
gate_mapping.E6: Full result bytes, artifact/receipt and retained native identity checks plus successful post-rename file flush; only then final_barrier_confirmed.
gate_mapping.E7: Full M including T->W/U binding, successful own flush and content/identity check; only then marker_barrier_confirmed.
gate_mapping.E8: Unchanged S2-EO live confirmations, sources/reservations and clean closes required. Files alone after context loss yield at most COMPLETE_RECORDS_PRESENT_UNCONFIRMED.

static_evidence.evidence_limit: Static source/JSON/hash consistency only; no native identity, rights, durability, code execution or platform capability observed.

next_step: Separate S2-EP static re-audit of EP-B01 and EP-B02. No implicit implementation or S2-EM release.
